name: ntfy
description: Simple HTTP-based pub-sub notification service. Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via scripts.
summary: ntfy v2.22.0 (released 2026-04-21) is the latest release, addressing a security fix for an SSRF vulnerability in the web push endpoint (GHSA-w9hq-5jg7-q4j7) and several web app bug fixes. Recent notable additions include S3-compatible object storage for attachments (v2.20.0), PostgreSQL read replica support (v2.19.0), verified email recipient enforcement via smtp-sender-verify (v2.21.0), and full PostgreSQL backend support introduced in v2.18.0. The project is actively maintained with frequent releases in 2026. Release notes are available at https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Apache 2.0 (server) and GPL (client) — dual-licensed; check repository for specifics
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in early 2026, most recently v2.22.0 on 2026-04-21
answers.Does it support authentication and acces: Yes — access tokens, user authentication, and per-topic access control are supported

breaking_excerpts: v2.20.0: ntfy will take full control over the attachment directory or S3 bucket — files matching the message ID format with no database entries will be deleted. Do not reuse attachment-cache-dir for other purposes.
v2.21.0: ntfy.sh now requires email address verification (smtp-sender-verify) before sending email notifications, following AWS SES account suspension due to unsolicited emails.
v2.22.0: Web push endpoint allow-list regex tightened to prevent SSRF (GHSA-w9hq-5jg7-q4j7) — previously unanchored pattern may have permitted unintended endpoints.

alternatives.name: Pushover
alternatives.review: Paid SaaS, simple API, iOS/Android apps.

alternatives.name: Gotify
alternatives.review: Self-hosted only, real-time push via WebSocket.

alternatives.name: Apprise
alternatives.review: Apprise is a powerful open-source notification library supporting 80+ services but is a library/CLI tool rather than a standalone pub-sub server with its own push infrastructure.

alternatives.name: Pushbullet
alternatives.review: Pushbullet provides cross-device notifications and file sharing with a user-friendly interface but is a closed-source cloud service with a restrictive free tier.

alternatives.name: Ntopng Alerts / Grafana Alerting
alternatives.review: Grafana Alerting is a robust enterprise-grade alerting system with rich integrations but is designed for monitoring dashboards rather than lightweight scriptable pub-sub notifications.
